title: Basement Floor Sub
description: A dark, dry square sub bass for a euro-dance-pop floor: clicky and controlled up front, then it slowly degrades over a 32-cycle loop as a saw LFO bleeds the bit depth down and drags a resonant ladder filter shut. Rhythmic tremolo gating and a creeping pan keep the controlled low end alive and club-ready.
code:
setcpm(128/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 g0 c1 c1 eb1 g0 c1>*2").s("square")
    .ftype("ladder")
    .lpf(saw.slow(32).range(620, 110))
    .resonance(saw.slow(23).range(6, 14))
    .lpenv(saw.slow(29).range(1.5, 4))
    .lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.07)
    .penv(7).pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.035)
    .crush(saw.slow(32).range(16, 5))
    .coarse(saw.slow(16).range(1, 5))
    .tremolosync("<2 4 4 8>/4").tremolodepth(saw.slow(13).range(0.1, 0.55))
    .shape(saw.slow(11).range(0.1, 0.4))
    .pan(tri.slow(7).range(0.35, 0.65))
    .gain(0.95)
)
